hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip install --quiet uv; for tool in ruff ty pyrefly mypy isort pyupgrade flake8 tombi pycroscope; do uv tool install --quiet "$tool" || echo "could not install $tool" >&2; done; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; exit 0
